recipes.name: Campbell’s Green Bean Casserole
ingredients_raw: 2 (10.75 ounce) cans Campbell's® Condensed Cream of Mushroom Soup or Campbell's® Condensed 98% Fat Free Cream of Mushroom Soup

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Stir 1 1/3 cups fried onions, green beans, soup, milk, soy sauce, and pepper together in a 3-quart casserole dish until evenly combined.
Bake uncovered in the preheated oven until sauce is hot and bubbling, about 25 minutes.
Stir the casserole and top with the remaining 1 1/3 cups fried onions. Bake until the topping is crisp and golden, about 5 minutes more. Let stand for a few minutes before serving.

raw_recipe.headline: Campbell’s Green Bean Casserole
raw_recipe.description: Make Campbell’s green bean casserole with tender green beans, cream of mushroom soup, and crispy fried onions for an easy Thanksgiving or Christmas side dish.

video.description: Update the classic holiday dish with bacon, red peppers, or almonds.

review.reviewBody: We love green bean casserole, but find this recipe just seems to use too much milk. The sauce seems overly thin. I use somewhere between 1/3 to 1/2 cup of milk and it is just perfect; thick and creamy. I omit the soy sauce as I think this recipe is great without it and to cut down on the sodium.

My family loves this recipe, but I’ve found that sometimes it can end up runny even though I didn’t change anything. I have found that draining my beans well made all the difference! I bought 4 cans on beans three of them regular cut and one French cut. I drained them well and put them in a container I put paper towel at the top of the container put the lid on and flipped it upside down and placed it in the fridge over night. The next morning I discarded the paper towel and put a new piece and returned the container to upside down position until I was ready to use it

This Thanksgiving I wanted to experiment a bit. 
 I used one can of roasted garlic cream of mushroom soup and a can of regular. I also used 3/4 cup of evaporated milk and a 1/4 cup milk. One teaspoon Dales steak seasoning and one teaspoon Kikkoman soy sauce. I ground black pepper to taste which was probably a little more than they measured out.

I used a generic store brand French onion which I measured then rough chopped to mix in. I also added about a 1/4- 1/3 cup fine shredded sharp cheddar cheese into the mix (this was my first time using cheese in this recipe I was very nervous to go overboard). I followed the baking instructions an topped off with the remaining French fried onions in the bag that I rough chopped. A 6oz bag worked well for me. I was able to cover my 9x13 baking dish with topping.
I add an extra can of soup and reduce the milk so it has a very thick consistency . It reduced the overall cook time and reduced the "runny" that the original had.

It was just like Gammy's used to be. I forgot her recipe so came here to find it. I followed the "1/2" recipe for three people. I read reviews, drained cans of beans and then tipped them upside down onto paper towels for two hours in the fridge so it wasn't "runny". I added 1/2 cup more onions to the mixture recipe than called for and the best part, I added a 1/2 cup of havarti cheese! Then at the final crisp, I put a 1/4 cup more havarti cheese on top of the remaining onions to melt on top. Super creamy and a perfect crunch! I did bake it 8 more minutes than called for, until I saw bubbles throughout. It was super creamy, excellent flavor and the crunch on top was divine!

Five stars because of some changes-I omitted the soy sauce and instead of cream of mushroom soup, I used cream of chicken soup. I also added freshly shredded smoked Gouda cheese (1/4-1/2 cup or as much as you want) along with a 1/4 cup of freshly grated Parmesan/Romano cheese and added a bit more fried onions into the mix (and on top of course). Always turns out fantastic.

This has been my Thanksgiving staple for well over 10 yrs. It is the one dish my family insists I alone make. I make mine a bit different though... This is for 24 servings [BIG family]: I omit the soy sauce, use nonfat or skim milk 2 cups for 24 servings), I add 1 whole tsp of pepper instead of just a 1/2, I add 1 whole pack of bacon (I bake it in the oven & chop it into bits), & I add 1/2 cup mild cheddar cheese (grated). Lastly, I add an extra cup or so of the french fried onions for more crunch in the green bean mix & as the finisher on top. My additions have never failed me. I've made this recipe for charity dinners around the holidays & expanded to feed 150+ people. Always gets rave reviews!

Green bean casserole is my families favorite dish on Thanksgiving! I dont add milk and i add 3 cups cooked rice and a block of shredded sharp cheddar cheese with green beans and cream of mushroom listed and i use frenchs onion on top of casserole and its delicious! Wont disappoint!
Yes, I made minor changes; substitute sour cream for the milk to make more creamy and add French onions in the last five minutes of cooking to add crispy texture.
Add 2 cans of mushroom pieces, shredded cheddar cheese, and 1 can of water chestnuts, chopped up, and LOTS of french-fried onions.

Classic recipe. I used frozen green beans (32 oz) cooked according to the package. Combined rest of ingredients as instructed reducing milk a little and only 1 tsp of soy sauce. I could add just a bit more green beans b/c the package didn't quite come to 8 cups but it was also just fine with the 32 oz package.
I made this and sauteed fresh minced garlic in a press and added 2% milk with some butter on a 1/2 sized recipe 6 servings i put in 4 pats of butter it turned out delicious!
My daughter started making this recipe adding the optional 1/2 cup of chopped red peppers and it is the ONLY green bean casserole that I’ve ever liked! It’s absolutely delicious!
holiday tradition! t's truly the essential comfort food.
I did add shredded cheese and omitted the soy sauce. Plus crispy chopped bacon added to the top as well. Mushrooms are also a good addition to the bean mixture.
Hunt for this recipe every year ... it's the easiest and the BEST ! LEFT OVER GO WITH EVERYTHING ... OR ALONE !!
I always drain 1sm can of mushrooms &add it to the mix! ❤️‍🔥
I added Velveeta Cheese to the mixture and also added crumple Bacon on the top
